asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_2 (female grad student, green sun hat, green skirt) is measuring a broad, fleshy footprint in reddish-brown mud with her checkered scale bar.

visual_notes.ichnology: Tracks are broad and robust. The hand prints are rotated significantly outward. The rear feet show deep, wide toe depressions. All claw marks are rendered as V-shaped cavities where mud has been displaced and pushed upward around the hole.
visual_notes.ground: Variegated reddish-brown iron-rich clay with small shallow turquoise pools.
